display.purpose: Rare entry or login statement; do not use for routine dashboard content.

headline.purpose: Page and record headings with a compact technical silhouette.

title.purpose: Section and card headings in the operational hierarchy.

body.purpose: Readable Chinese-first descriptions, form fields, and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, statuses, metadata, actions, and compact numeric context.

shadows.name: ambient-surface
shadows.purpose: Soft lift for data surfaces and cards in light mode.

shadows.name: lifted-layer
shadows.purpose: Stronger elevation for detail heroes and saved-state feedback in light mode.

shadows.name: transient-overlay
shadows.purpose: Command search and other transient overlays only.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button, icon, border, color, and hover state changes.

motion.name: sheet-enter
motion.purpose: Right-side form sheet entering from the edge.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for animation and transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confident action for creating or committing a work item.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 15px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; background: var(--navy); font: 650 12px/1.4 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .18s ease, background .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A low-risk companion action on a surface background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--navy); background: var(--surface); font: 650 12px/1.4 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .18s ease, background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan-soft); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A readable field for a label-led form or search interaction.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 600 13px/1.4 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); font: 400 15px/1.6 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-subtle); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 14%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: A 43 px rail item that makes the current research area obvious.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; min-height: 43px; padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; border-radius: 10px; color: #8fa7bd; background: transparent; font: 560 14px/1.4 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: #fff; background: rgba(55,215,210,.12); } .ds-nav-item i { position: absolute; right: -14px; width: 3px; height: 24px; border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px; background: #37d7d2; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #37d7d2 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Data Panel
components.description: A quiet surface for a timeline, risk list, snapshot, or activity feed.
components.html:
近期节点

截止时间与优先级合并排序
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 2px; font: 650 17px/1.35 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 12px/1.6 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic status that always pairs color with text.
components.css: .ds-status-success { min-height: 25px; padding: 3px 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--success); background: var(--success-soft); font: 650 11px/1.4 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: A compact task unit inside the horizontally scrollable four-column board.
components.html:
高优先级

整理距离保护仿真算例

独立任务 · 研究项目
components.css: .ds-task-card { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(8,43,85,.045); } .ds-task-chip { min-height: 22px; padding: 3px 7px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-soft); font: 700 9px/1.4 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-task-card h3 { margin: 10px 0 5px; font: 650 13px/1.45 "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-task-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 10px/1.6 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; }

components.name: Command Search
components.description: A centered keyboard-friendly search surface for cross-record retrieval.
components.html:
⌕Ctrl K
输入至少两个字符…
components.css: .ds-command { width: min(680px, calc(100vw - 30px)); max-height: 68vh; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,14,33,.32); } .ds-command-input { height: 60px; padding: 0 14px 0 19px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-command-input input { min-height: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; box-shadow: none; background: transparent; font: 400 16px/1.6 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-command-input kbd { margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink-subtle); background: var(--surface-2); font: 400 11px/1.4 "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-command-hint { padding: 45px 20px; color: var(--ink-subtle); text-align: center; font: 400 12px/1.6 "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
电研工作台 is a calm, precise operating surface for a power-systems researcher. The visual language treats attention like an engineering signal: deep navy establishes a stable frame, electric cyan marks the live path, and cool paper surfaces keep dense records readable. It is a working dashboard, not a promotional page; hierarchy and evidence outrank decoration.

The default light theme uses tonal layering, compact controls, and restrained borders to make deadlines, risk, progress, and linked evidence easy to scan. Dark mode keeps the same information architecture while shifting the paper and surfaces into a blue-black range with brighter text and cyan. No photographic or illustrative imagery is part of the system: icons, signal bars, progress tracks, and CSS geometry are sufficient for this operational data UI.
keyCharacteristics: Action before analytics: deadlines and risk lead aggregate output counts.
Deep navy structure with an electric cyan signal accent.
Cool, low-contrast surfaces and thin dividers instead of ornamental decoration.
Chinese-first readability with Manrope numerals and compact metadata.
Zero-image interface: represent research state with data, icons, and geometry.

rules.name: The Signal-First Rule
rules.body: Cyan is a signal, not a wallpaper: reserve it for active navigation, links, controls, progress, focus, and meaningful status.

rules.name: The Numeric Clarity Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for prominent counts and tabular numerals, and never rely on color alone to communicate a deadline, priority, or completion state.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface, line, and spacing first; use a shadow only when an element is genuinely lifted or transient.

dos: Do keep the light theme as the default and preserve the same semantic roles when adding dark-mode tokens.
Do lead dashboard surfaces with deadlines, risk, and next actions before aggregate counts.
Do use cyan sparingly for active state, links, progress, focus, and signal-bearing icons.
Do preserve Chinese readability, visible focus, keyboard operation, and 200% text-zoom behavior.
Do use icons, dividers, progress, and CSS geometry to communicate power-systems context; this UI intentionally ships with zero images.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences; transitions and skeleton shimmer must collapse to near-instant motion.
donts: Don't add stock photography, decorative hero illustrations, or image-heavy backgrounds to operational screens.
Don't use cyan as a large decorative fill or as the only distinction between status states.
Don't replace the action-first dashboard hierarchy with a marketing-style hero or oversized visualization.
Don't shrink tables, kanban columns, or form controls below their readable widths; allow the established horizontal scroll behavior.
Don't introduce sharp corners, excessive pills, heavy gradients, or unscoped shadows that compete with the signal hierarchy.
